These two icons are used only in the Missile Silo guide sheet (a documentation image), which paints them in and
is therefore a combined work: that sheet is marked GPL-3.0 in docs/assets/CREDITS.md. The icons live with the
infographic tool inputs, not in src/main/resources, so the mod jar does not contain them.
